title: quotas: Quota name/description localizable and RFC 9425 Accept-Language selection (after JMAP-1igi)
description:
Quotas (RFC 9425), after JMAP-1igi lands: Quota `name` and `description` are localizable. Both are server-set, so the server populates locale and localizations itself.
- Without i18n in `using`: select `description` by Accept-Language, as RFC 9425 4.1 MUST. This needs the CallerCtx Accept-Language accessor (decision .1(h)).
- With i18n: base values plus all localizations, and `language` selects. The draft "Updates: 9425" for opt-in clients.
Blocked on JMAP-1igi. Once that epic is decomposed, this may move under it.
